title: 016 - Average Marks
prompt: Fix the bug so the program calculate the average mark and print 20 and prints exactly `20`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
def average_marks(values):
    return len([value for value in values if value >= 0])
solutionCode:
def average_marks(values):
    return len([value for value in values if value > 0])
hint: Check the value used as the divisor.
explanation: The average divides by the wrong length. Dividing by the full number of marks fixes the answer.
